question: Produce seven additional lawful, target-free, per-unit source observables for the cp1792 development tape, bit-parity-preserving the sealed v3 host rollout, so exactly one widened retrain of the frozen J architecture can test whether source-side information moves the 3.233e-8 observer plateau.

information_novelty_screen.rule: A new channel must not be a deterministic per-unit function of the existing 20 channels.
information_novelty_screen.rejected_candidate: The Hermite-series diagonal load fraction was rejected because the series diagonal equals the sum of squared Hermite coefficients, a pure function of alpha (channel 3) given channels 6 and 11.
information_novelty_screen.accepted_basis: The seven accepted channels draw on three objects the sealed tape never exports: the discarded CP3 components at each cap event, the tenth correlation power's row coupling, and the correlation-matrix row structure beyond its three exported moments.

frozen_source_chain.immutability: The sealed v3 store is never written; this package writes only its own new directory.

channel_definitions.convention: All computations replicate the v3 _host_tape loop operation-for-operation in flopscope.numpy under one BudgetContext(2^41) per row with BASE._CP_CAP=1792; new quantities use separate variables and never mutate host state. Channels are computed in float64 and stored as float32, exactly like raw32.
channel_definitions.indexing: Layer index l is 0-based over 16 layers. The cap event at the end of layer l-1 defines the discarded component set D(l) entering layer l; D(0) is empty and D(l) is empty when no cap event occurred.

channels.name: discarded_k3_signed
channels.definition: With (lambda_D, p_D, q_D) the components discarded at the end of layer l-1 (columns in layer l-1 unit basis), pushed_pD = transpose(W32_l) @ p_D, pushed_qD = transpose(W32_l) @ q_D, k3D = 3*((pushed_pD*pushed_pD*pushed_qD) @ lambda_D); channel = k3D / max(sigma^3, 1e-45). Zero vector when D(l) is empty.

channels.name: discarded_k3_absolute
channels.definition: 3*((|pushed_pD*pushed_pD*pushed_qD|) @ |lambda_D|) / max(sigma^3, 1e-45). Zero vector when D(l) is empty.

channels.name: covariance_series_order10_row_share
channels.definition: With c10 = Hermite coefficient order 10 and P10 = elementwise tenth power of the correlation matrix (the final correlation_power of the series loop), channel = (c10 * (P10 @ c10)) / max(series_diag, 2^-40) where series_diag = sum over orders 1..10 of the squared Hermite coefficients.

channels.name: max_offdiagonal_abs_correlation
channels.definition: max over j of |rho_ij| with the exact unit diagonal removed by subtracting the identity from |rho| before the row maximum.

channels.name: coincident_bond_degree
channels.definition: count over j of (|rho_ij| - identity_ij) > 0.9, divided by 1024.

channels.name: rho2_neighbor_skew
channels.definition: ((rho*rho) @ (k3/max(sigma^3,1e-45))) / 1024, using the same per-unit k3 vector as existing channel 10.

parity_law.requirement: For every row, the recomputed 20-channel raw32, host, and sigma arrays must reproduce the sealed v3 row's recorded array_sha256 values exactly, and every one of the 16 recomputed entering-CP state hashes must equal the sealed row manifest's entering_cp_state_hashes.
parity_law.on_any_mismatch: Abort the entire generation; no partial store is used for any training.
parity_law.meaning: This proves the augmentation is purely additive observation over the identical host rollout, and it is the generation stage's positive control.

storage_layout.weights_and_original_channels: Never duplicated; consumers join this store with the sealed v3 store by role_rank and mlp_id.
storage_layout.resumability: Completed rows are skipped by verifying their existing manifest; partial rows are regenerated.

scope_and_firewalls.target_free: The generator reads only weights and sealed v3 receipts; no target file is opened at any point.

generation_gate.fail: Close the generation attempt with a defect receipt; do not train on any partial or parity-failed store.

native_analog_map_and_transfer_firewall.frame_fact: The cp1792 development host (learned_residual_observer_design/v3/estimator.py, HERMITE_ORDER 10, CP3-only, cap 1792) and the Q24 deployment host (fullbudget_k21_k4_closure_q24_manual_rho_hybrid_*_v1/estimator.py, Q24 Mehler terms 0..24, CP3 cap 16384 never reached, CP4 cap 2048, PSD repair) are different estimators. The Q24-native instrumented tape (public_q24_native_transport_energy_pilot_v1/instrumented_estimator.py, sha f539889324fb82cc1ded35a41c8b5a359014d9ddac52eab62949257e8e58a0ef) already hardcodes channel 2 retained_fraction to 1.0 because CP3 never truncates natively.

per_channel_native_analogs.20_21_discarded_k3: No literal native CP3 analog (cap never binds). The native instances of the same discarded-higher-order-mass mechanism are the CP4 dropped planes materialized exactly at _cp4_reset lines 969-973 (13 cap events per forward, currently discarded), the cubic star k21_target - cp_post_k21 at _reset_stars line 1132, and the quartic star at lines 1158-1171.
per_channel_native_analogs.22_series_order10_row_share: Native analog: the t=24 Mehler slice of the _g_four_all einsum (last kept term, materialized in pair_left/pair_right/powers[24]); terms t=25..30 are additionally computable natively without new Hermite work because the coefficient table already carries q<=38.
per_channel_native_analogs.23_26_correlation_graph: Direct native analogs: the Q24 fusion correlation matrix exists at _q24_context (clipped to [-1,1] at lines 457-461); identical row-structure channels are computable there.

native_analog_map_and_transfer_firewall.two_stage_law: This development-frame arm is a capacity screen only. A pass licenses exactly one separately preregistered NATIVE augmentation stage (instrumented-estimator export of the native-instance observables plus a ~6.1-hour 688-row retape at 3 workers x 2 threads, nice 10) with its own seal, audit, and gates. No development-frame result, pass or fail, licenses any deployment claim or any change to the banked H7B submission chain.

one_arm_law_downstream: Exactly one widened retrain of the frozen J architecture (separately preregistered CV package) may consume this store; no channel-subset sweeps.
